title: Remote run's authenticated native origin facts never reach Central (08431-FULL-1: facts=null, association_stale for 2h40m)
outcome:
Report from Engram::Fable (TermAl mailbox ebe242f7 #8492, 06:53Z). Engram::Merger (session-11859, claim holder of Engram w-08431f15a711) registered a test-run wait and a native-run lookup for DL560 s4's run test-b79d1765-f547-4761-84ca-64d8aad25d49: started about 04:15Z, typed request #391, committed_input 603a4d60, landing_gate, work revision 2. From 04:19Z to 06:53Z the lookup returns facts=null with association_stale "awaiting authenticated native origin facts", and no END reached the runner mailbox after #392. This blocks the P0 landing and the EO C1 witness.
Context: the Central–DL560 federation link churned all morning, with drops at 04:20, 04:22, 04:33–04:39, 05:33–05:54 and 06:02 (w-70d8b360cdc3), and has been down since 06:02:37Z.
Open question: was the run's terminal fact emitted on DL560 during a link drop and never re-sent after reconnect (a K3 fact delivery and retry defect), or is it simply held until the link returns? Expected behaviour: authenticated native origin facts are durably retained on the producing host and delivered once any authenticated link is available, with no manual resend.
acceptance: It is established from DL560's retained run records and Central's lookup state whether test-b79d1765's terminal facts were emitted, when, and why they did not reach Central: held by the link outage, or dropped or not retried after reconnects.

If it is a defect, a behaviour test reproduces a terminal fact emitted during a link drop, and after the fix it is delivered after re-establishment, with no manual resend and no rerun. The test uses no wall-clock thresholds.
The review pair is clean, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
